items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: You know, John was married to the great singer, Maxine Sullivan.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Next in line here is John Kirby, whom you've mentioned already.

John Kirby. Now there's a guy. He was a real character. You know, John was married to the great singer, Maxine Sullivan. In later years this happened. But John had a great little six piece combo that played some of the major hotels in the country. That was a great group. In fact, that's -- he was a great tuba player originally, and he played tuba with Fletcher starting out, but he also played the string bass. And he was one of the few bass players that had a string bass that was a tin. When I say tin, you know,…
Oh, yes. It's metal. Metal, uh-huh.
